chapters.name: 🟦 1. 通用短语（最常出现，RS 核心词组）

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: He left early, according to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 根据老师的说法，他早早离开了。
words.en: In accordance with or as stated by something.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: You can have at most three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: You use at most or at the most to say that a number or amount is the maximum that is possible and that the actual number or amount may be smaller.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；和...形成对照
words.ex: He likes coffee, in contrast to his sister who likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，而他的妹妹喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.ex: He is cooking dinner. In the meantime, she is setting the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做晚饭，与此同时，她正在摆桌子。
words.en: In the meantime is used to indicate that something else is happening or will happen while a particular event or situation is continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；长期地
words.ex: In the long term, eating healthy helps you feel better.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食让你感觉更好。
words.en: Over a long period of time in the future.

words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

chapters.name: 🟧 2. 校园类高频短语（RS 必考）

words.tr: phrase. 课程大纲；课程教学计划
words.ex: The teacher gave us the course outline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程大纲。
words.en: A document that lists the topics and schedule for a course.

words.tr: phrase. 网上门户；在线平台
words.ex: Students use the online portal to submit their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生使用网上门户提交作业。
words.en: A website or digital platform providing access to specific services, information, or resources.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture theatre for biology class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去讲堂上生物课。
words.en: A large room or hall used for lectures, typically with tiered seating for the audience.

words.tr: phrase. 办公时间；营业时间；教师答疑时间
words.ex: The teacher is available during office hours.
words.ex_cn: 老师在办公时间有空。
words.en: The times during which a person, especially a professional, is available for consultation or work in their office.

words.tr: phrase. 学术诚信；指在学术活动中坚持诚实、公正和负责任的原则，杜绝抄袭、作弊和伪造数据等不端行为
words.ex: Students must show academic integrity by not cheating on exams.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须通过不考试作弊来展现学术诚信。
words.en: The ethical principle of being truthful and original in academic work.

words.tr: phrase. 评估标准；评定准则
words.ex: The teacher explained the assessment criteria for the final project.
words.ex_cn: 老师解释了期末项目的评估标准。
words.en: Assessment criteria are the standards or benchmarks used to evaluate or judge the quality, performance, or suitability of something.

words.tr: phrase. 学生住宿；专为学生提供的居住场所
words.ex: The student lives in student accommodation near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生住在靠近校园的学生宿舍里。
words.en: Housing provided for students, typically by educational institutions or private landlords, to live in while they are studying.

words.tr: phrase. 学习资源；教学资料
words.ex: The school provides free learning resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费的学习资源。
words.en: Materials or tools that are used to facilitate learning and education.

words.tr: phrase. 学生服务（指为学生提供的各类支持与帮助，如咨询、住宿、就业指导等）
words.ex: The student services office helps with housing and loans.
words.ex_cn: 学生服务中心帮助解决住宿和贷款问题。
words.en: Student services refer to the range of support services provided by educational institutions to assist students in their academic and personal development. These services can include academic advising, counseling, career services, and health services, among others.

words.tr: phrase. 辅导课；教学辅导时段
words.ex: The tutorial session helps students understand math easily.
words.ex_cn: 辅导课帮助学生轻松理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial session is a period of instruction given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students, focusing on a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 小组作业；团队任务（指由一组学生共同完成的学术任务）
words.ex: We did a group assignment in math class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在数学课上做了一个小组作业。
words.en: A task or project that is assigned to a group of students to work on together, often requiring collaboration and division of tasks among group members.

words.ex: The teacher checks the attendance sheet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 老师每天早上都会检查出勤表。
words.en: A document or digital record used to track the presence or absence of individuals, typically in a class or meeting.

words.tr: phrase. 留学项目；海外学习计划
words.ex: He joined a study abroad program in Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了在日本的留学项目。
words.en: An educational program where students travel to another country to study for a semester or year.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 课程资料；教学材料
words.ex: The professor distributed the course materials at the beginning of the semester.
words.ex_cn: 教授在学期初分发了课程教材。
words.en: Materials used in a course of study, including textbooks, articles, and other resources provided by the instructor.

words.tr: phrase. 最终考试；期末考试
words.ex: He is preparing for the final examination next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期末考试做准备。
words.en: A final examination is a test given to students at the end of a course of study or training.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室设备；用于科学实验的仪器和装置
words.ex: The students cleaned the laboratory equipment after the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验后清理了实验室设备。
words.en: Tools, machines, and other items used in a laboratory for conducting experiments or research.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆数据库；用于管理图书资源和借阅信息的电子数据库系统
words.ex: I searched the library database for books on history.
words.ex_cn: 我通过图书馆数据库搜索历史书籍。
words.en: A structured collection of books, journals, and other resources, often searchable electronically.

words.tr: phrase. 研究设施；科研机构；实验设备
words.ex: The university has modern research facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学有现代化的研究设施。
words.en: Buildings, equipment, and services provided for the purpose of conducting research.

chapters.name: 🟩 3. 情景类高频短语（PTE 最爱考）

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: He works for environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 他从事环境保护工作。
words.en: Environmental protection refers to the practice of protecting the natural environment by individuals, organizations and governments. Its objectives are to conserve natural resources and the existing natural environment and, where possible, to repair damage and reverse trends.

words.ex: The country wants economic development to help its people.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望经济发展来帮助人民。
words.en: Economic development refers to the process by which the economic well-being and quality of life of a nation, region, or local community are improved according to targeted goals and objectives.

words.ex: The city is dealing with population growth.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市正在应对人口增长。
words.en: The increase in the number of people living in a particular area.

words.ex: He does scientific research in a lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室做科学研究。
words.en: Scientific research refers to the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；研究发现
words.ex: The scientists shared their research findings with the public.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们将他们的研究发现与公众分享。
words.en: The results or outcomes of a study or investigation.

words.tr: phrase. 科学证据；指通过科学方法获得并能支持或反驳某一主张的数据或事实
words.ex: The doctor used scientific evidence to explain the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 医生用科学证据来解释这种治疗方法。
words.en: Information obtained through scientific methods that supports or refutes a theory, hypothesis, or claim.

words.ex: He does data analysis for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他工作做数据分析。
words.en: The process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data.

words.ex: The city celebrates cultural diversity with many food festivals.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市通过许多美食节庆祝文化多样性。
words.en: Cultural diversity refers to the existence of a variety of cultural or ethnic groups within a society.

words.tr: phrase. 社会问题；指影响社会成员福祉、引发公共关注与讨论的议题，如贫困、教育不平等、种族歧视等
words.ex: He talks about social issues in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上谈论社会问题。
words.en: Social issues are matters which directly or indirectly affect many or all members of a society and are considered to be problems, controversies related to moral values, or both.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传工程；基因工程
words.ex: Scientists use genetic engineering to change plant genes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用基因工程来改变植物的基因。
words.en: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗；治疗；医学处理
words.ex: He needs medical treatment for his broken leg.
words.ex_cn: 他需要为断掉的腿接受治疗。
words.en: Medical treatment refers to the management and care of a patient to combat disease or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 技术创新；科技革新
words.ex: The company focuses on technological innovation to grow faster.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司专注于技术创新以更快发展。
words.en: The process of translating an idea or invention into a good or service that creates value or for which customers will pay.

words.ex: He is learning artificial intelligence at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习人工智能。
words.en: Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.tr: phrase. 可再生能源（指可自然补充的能源，如太阳能、风能、水能等）
words.ex: The town uses renewable energy to power its lights.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用可再生能源来供电。
words.en: Renewable energy is energy that is collected from renewable resources, which are naturally replenished on a human timescale, such as sunlight, wind, rain, tides, waves, and geothermal heat.

chapters.name: 🟥 4. 动词高频搭配（最常出现在 RS 句子中）

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

chapters.name: 🟫 5. 名词高频搭配（SGD / RS 高频）

words.ex: He is working on a research project about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。
words.en: A research project is a detailed and careful study of a specific topic or problem, often carried out over a period of time and involving the collection and analysis of information.

words.ex: We use different research methods in our study.
words.ex_cn: 我们在研究中使用了不同的研究方法。
words.en: Research methods refer to the techniques and procedures used to conduct research. They include the ways in which data is collected, analyzed, and interpreted to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.tr: phrase. 数据收集；资料采集
words.ex: The teacher uses data collection to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用数据收集来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of gathering information or data from various sources for analysis or processing.

words.ex: He does data analysis for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他工作做数据分析。
words.en: The process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data.

words.tr: phrase. 统计模型：用于描述数据生成过程或变量间关系的数学结构，常用于推断、预测或假设检验
words.ex: The scientist used a statistical model to predict the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一个统计模型来预测天气。
words.en: A statistical model is a mathematical model that embodies a set of statistical assumptions concerning the generation of sample data. It is typically specified as a mathematical relationship between one or more random variables and other non-random variables.

words.tr: phrase. 财务支持；经济援助
words.ex: He got financial support from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济支持。
words.en: Financial support refers to the provision of money or resources to help someone or something, especially in the context of education, business, or personal needs.

words.ex: The job offers good health benefits.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作提供良好的医疗福利。
words.en: Health benefits refer to the positive effects on health that result from certain actions, such as exercise, diet, or abstaining from harmful habits.

words.tr: phrase. 学术成功；学业成就
words.ex: He works hard for academic success.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以取得学业上的成功。
words.en: Achievement in educational pursuits, often measured by grades, awards, and the attainment of degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 教育系统；教育体制
words.ex: The education system in this country is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的教育制度非常严格。
words.en: The structured framework within which educational activities are organized and conducted, including the policies, institutions, and practices that guide teaching and learning.

words.ex: He improved his communication skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中提高了沟通技能。
words.en: Communication skills refer to the ability to convey information to another effectively and efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 经济因素；影响经济状况的各种要素，如通货膨胀、利率、就业率等
words.ex: Economic factors such as inflation and unemployment rates can significantly impact a country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 经济因素，如通货膨胀率和失业率，可以显著影响一个国家的经济。
words.en: Economic factors refer to the elements that influence the economic state of a country or region, including inflation, unemployment rates, and GDP growth.

words.ex: He takes public transportation to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transportation refers to the system of buses, trains, subways, etc., that is available for use by the public and is usually operated by a government or private company.

words.ex: The government policy helps poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府政策帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: A government policy is a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government.

words.tr: phrase. 环境问题；与自然环境相关的各种问题，如污染、气候变化、资源枯竭等
words.ex: Many people care about environmental issues.
words.ex_cn: 许多人关心环境问题。
words.en: Environmental issues refer to problems related to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

chapters.name: 🟪 6. 介词短语（最容易考听力拼写）

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.ex: He wrote the letter by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他亲手写了这封信。
words.en: If something is done by hand, it is done using someone's hands rather than a machine.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: In theory, the plan works well.
words.ex_cn: 理论上，这个计划效果很好。
words.en: If you say that something is true in theory, you mean that it is supposed to be true according to a set of ideas or principles, but in practice it may not be true.

words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

chapters.name: 🟣 10. 超高频 RS 神句短语（出现次数最多）

words.w: will be available on the website
words.uk: wɪl bi əˈveɪləbl ɒn ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt
words.us: wɪl bi əˈveɪləbl ɑːn ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt
words.en: Something will be accessible for viewing or use on a website at a specified time.

words.ex: The meeting will take place in room 205.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在205房间举行。
words.en: An event or activity is scheduled to occur in a particular room or location.

words.ex: Exercise is an important aspect of a healthy life.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼是健康生活的一个重要方面。
words.en: A significant or essential part or feature of something.

words.ex: This theory has been widely accepted by scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这一理论已被科学家广泛接受。
words.en: Something has been accepted or adopted by a large number of people or groups.

words.ex: The price of bread is expected to increase next month.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格预计下个月将增加。
words.en: Likely to grow or become greater in amount or size.

words.ex: This book is widely considered to be the best introduction to physics.
words.ex_cn: 这本书被广泛认为是最好的物理入门书。
words.en: Generally believed or accepted by many people.

words.tr: phrase. 在……中起重要作用；在……扮演重要角色
words.ex: Water plays an important role in keeping the body healthy.
words.ex_cn: 水在保持身体健康方面起着重要作用。
words.en: Has a significant function or influence in a particular situation or system.

words.ex: Exercise is closely related to good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康密切相关。
words.en: Having a strong connection or similarity in nature or characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 在很大程度上依赖于
words.ex: The success of the project is largely dependent on teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成功在很大程度上依赖于团队合作。
words.en: Mainly determined or affected by something else.
